Run these ripgrep commands and return ALL results with file:line and the matching line content:

1. `rg -n 'JSON\.parse\(JSON\.stringify' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts' -g '!*.spec.ts'`
2. `rg -n 'structuredClone' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts' -g '!*.spec.ts'`
3. `rg -n 'rebuild|reindex|recompute|re-compute' /tmp/ruflo/v3 -g '!node_modules' -g '!*.test.ts' -g '!*.spec.ts'`
4. Also search the ruvector, memory, embeddings directories specifically:
   `rg -rn 'JSON\.parse\(JSON\.stringify|structuredClone' /tmp/ruflo/v3/@claude-flow/memory /tmp/ruflo/v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/memory 2>/dev/null`
5. `rg -rn 'JSON\.parse\(JSON\.stringify|structuredClone' /tmp/ruflo/plugins/gastown-bridge/src 2>/dev/null`
6. `rg -rn 'JSON\.parse\(JSON\.stringify|structuredClone' /tmp/ruflo/v3/@claude-flow/swarm/src/queen-coordinator.ts 2>/dev/null`

Return the raw rg output verbatim — every match line with file path and line number. Do NOT summarize or skip any matches. Do NOT read files yet, just return the grep hits.
